protocol.scope: Observable acceleration assessment before full-circuit controller work
protocol.development_evaluation: Only the previously declared held-out laps for each of the 21 fitted contexts
protocol.validation_prediction: Median predictions from unchanged development context fits with exactly matching session_name and DRS code; no validation fitting
protocol.constant_baseline: Mean acceleration on each original development fit's training laps; median of matching context means for transfer
protocol.aggregation: RMSE within event/session/driver/lap/DRS, then equal-weight mean across these groups per event; no sample independence or confidence claim
protocol.unmatched_validation: Record and exclude unmatched session_name/DRS; no fallback or silent remapping
protocol.extrapolation: Record fraction outside the common speed range shared by all transferred fits
protocol.reference_comparison: Evaluate unchanged base and maximum electrical power endpoints at observed speed; neither endpoint is a prediction of real deployment
protocol.decision_rule: Report model discrepancy descriptively. No post-hoc numerical empirical pass threshold. Keep the reference vehicle explicitly assumed; assess model-based controller comparisons separately.
protocol.protected: No test-role inputs; no fitting smoothing, grip, timing alignment or battery parameters from these straight-motion windows
